Original photography/brand/portrait identity and fine detail take priority over all other input. No alterations to books,plantleaves,sofastitching,lamp/reflections/cars or protected source media; no beautification. Whitepanel/neutralfineedge/restrainedshadow only, no mintgreen surface or greenbody. No new content, text, data, objects or controls. Approximatelysquare single component with modestwhite margins.
